title: Staggered activation velocity snapshot: NA/EU/APAC (Q3–Q4 2027)
content:
Purpose:
A compact working snapshot to align on staged activation (velocity) for GPU fleet adds across NA / EU / APAC from Oct 2026 through Jan 2027. This doc focuses on the operational tempo (how many racks/week), warm-window cadence, utilization targets, and emergency gates so SRE, Oncall, Capacity, and Cloud procurement can coordinate.
content_2:
Why this exists:
- We need a concise operational plan that engineers and oncall can follow during phased region rollouts.
- Existing forecasts are high-level; this is intentionally prescriptive (week-by-week-ish) with configurable gates.
- Emphasis on minimizing customer-impact risk while meeting projected demand growth and reserved-commit timing windows.
assumptions:
High-level assumptions (base):
- Target steady-state utilization: 60% average GPU utilization across serving pools (with bursts to 80% acceptable for <6h).
- Warm-up efficiency: new racks reach 70% of expected throughput within 72 hours given standard config/AMIs and staged traffic seeding.
- Preferred instance mix: H100 for high-throughput model lanes, A100 for general-purpose lanes. Planning uses H100-equivalence factor = 1.8 (1 H100 ~= 1.8 A100s for our baseline models).
- Safety buffer: initial activation includes +10% extra GPUs to account for slow provisioning/failed hardware.
- Autoscale: immediate autoscale configured but capped to reserved pool size during warm window to avoid uncontrolled spend.
activation_velocity_snapshot:
Planned activation cadence (week blocks, rough):
- Oct W1 (2026-10-04): NA: 6 racks (48 H100 total), EU: 2 racks (16 H100), APAC: hold; purpose = quick surge for holiday test traffic.
- Oct W3 (2026-10-18): NA: 4 racks, EU: 4 racks, APAC: 2 racks (start initial warm window in SIN).
- Nov W2 (2026-11-08): NA: 8 racks, EU: 6 racks, APAC: 6 racks; focus on opening dedicated capacity lanes for mid- and long-context workloads.
- Nov W4 (2026-11-22): NA: 6 racks (buffer), EU: 4 racks (latency lanes), APAC: 4 racks (capacity parity).
- Dec W2 (2026-12-06): NA: 10 racks (finalize H100 cluster for high throughput), EU: 6 racks, APAC: 8 racks (burst windows pre-holiday).
Notes: racks sized as 8xH100 equivalent for this plan; convert to A100 using equivalence factor where needed. Quantities include the +10% safety buffer. This schedule is intentionally staggered to align with vendor lead times and regional procurement cutoffs.
regional_breakdown_estimates:
Estimated GPU-equivalent capacity by month (H100-equivalent):
- Oct 2026 (end-of-month): NA = 120 H100-eq, EU = 48 H100-eq, APAC = 24 H100-eq (initial).
- Nov 2026: NA = 200 H100-eq, EU = 110 H100-eq, APAC = 80 H100-eq.
- Dec 2026: NA = 280 H100-eq, EU = 170 H100-eq, APAC = 140 H100-eq.
- Jan 2027 (target steady ramp): NA = 360 H100-eq, EU = 240 H100-eq, APAC = 220 H100-eq.
Operational note: convert to provider-specific shapes post-procurement; these are useful for scheduling warm windows and routing SLOs.
warm_window_and_oncall_cadence:
Warm-window plan (template):
- Pre-activation (72–48h before rack live): infra-ops runs imaging, network overlays, and telemetry gating.
- Day 0–1 (0–24h live): limited traffic seeding from internal test-apps, sampling at 10% of expected production.
- Day 2–3: escalate traffic to 50% if tail latency < SLO and error-rate < 0.5%.
- Day 4+: remove hard caps, promote to production routing.
Oncall staffing:
- During each warm-window we require: 1 infra-ops lead (owner), 1 SRE oncall (primary), 1 backend SW engineer (model-lane owner) during first 72h.
- Escalation path: infra-ops -> SRE lead -> platform-engineering -> vendor oncall (if hardware failure).
- Slack channel naming convention: #warm-<region>-<week> (e.g., #warm-na-oct-w1).
gates_and_triggers:
Gates (hard):
- Abort activation if provisioning failure rate > 8% across racks in 24h.
- Pause further activations if 95th-percentile tail latency increases by >20% vs baseline for >2h.
Soft triggers (monitoring):
- If average utilization exceeds 75% for >6h, queue next activation earlier by 1 week.
- If error-rate spikes >1% for model-lane, throttle traffic and open incident.
Metrics to publish each day of warm-window: provisioning success %, 95p latency, error-rate, GPU temperature hotspots, pod OOMs, KV cache hit rate.
risk_register_and_mitigations:
Top risks and mitigations:
- Vendor delivery slippage: pre-stage an extra rack in NA with flexible cancellation; keep a 2-week reorder lead built into calendar.
- Failed AMI/config drift: run nightly validation job against staging before imaging fleet; keep rollback AMIs indexed.
- Unexpected load pattern (bursty): enable immediate fallback to smaller-context model variants; configure automatic route-to-hosted-fallback lane for critical customers.
- Cooling/power constraints at colo: validate power budget before drawdown and stagger rack activation across PODs.
open_questions_and-decisions-needed:
- Final decision on H100 vs mixed A100/H100 in EU due by 2026-10-25 (affects procurement window).
- Confirm APAC initial zone (SIN vs SYD) tradeoffs — need latency heatmap for top 50 customers by footprint.
- Approve increased buffer (+10% -> +15%) if vendor reliability metrics remain below 95% for next 30 days.

footer: Status: Draft -> in_review. This is a pragmatic operational plan, not an exact procurement manifest. Revisit after first two activation waves to update velocity assumptions and warm-window timings.
